phase: Source, meaningful CPU proof tests and plain hostcheck only; no device ELF, Arena, serving or model activation.
source: Existing unbalanced WeightCpu::load: supplied F4 low/high nibbles multiplied by per16 finite E4 scale, rounded to BF16; unchanged inverse global and no native-E4 row-dequant. Layer0 UP/GATE/DOWN only.

contract.candidate0: Retain the exact existing rational code vector AND stored F32 scale s0=RN32(A*RN32(1/7)); do not recode candidate0 from s0.
contract.others: 25 fixed j=8..32 choices. fraction=j/32 is exact F32; scale=RN32(s0*fraction). For this stored scale choose exact-real nearest integer magnitude, ties away from zero, clipped to0..7; restore sign.
contract.selection: Compute exact-real sum((BF16 source)-(integer code)*(stored F32 scale))^2 in common2^-38 integer units. Candidate0 first; replace only on strict lower SSE, so all ties keep earliest candidate. All-zero groups retain original codes and scale without conversion to the nonzero grid.
contract.no_claim: Only no-worse exact-real weight-space SSE against the included baseline. RN32(code*scale) reconstruction SSE, partial F32 rounding, FFN output drift, model/task quality and speed are separate.

domain_and_bounds.domain: First enumerate all16 F4 codes times all254 finite E4 codes, verify product is exact BF16, and verify238 distinct nonnegative magnitudes including zero. Reject values outside this provided-weight domain.
domain_and_bounds.grid: Nonzero-domain source and all candidate stored F32 scales must be exact integer multiples of2^-38, verified from exponent/mantissa bits; zero-group floor scale is a preserved special case.
domain_and_bounds.overflow: Conservative per-error magnitude <=8192*2^38=2^51, group SSE <=960*(2^51)^2<2^112. Independently bound prefix counts/sums/sumsq and each intermediate of ss-2*q*s*sum+n*(q*s)^2; checked i128 arithmetic rejects overflow. Root owns separate Fraction proof.
domain_and_bounds.per_projection_aggregate: Each source and same-sign reconstruction is nonnegative in magnitude; x<=2688 and7*max_stored_scale=7*(12582913/32768)<4096. Thus every absolute source/error<4096*2^38=2^50. Each projection has58,982,400<2^26 values, so source norm and exact baseline/selected SSE sums<2^126, within signed i128. Checked additions still fail closed. This tighter aggregate bound is separate from the conservative per-group2^112 bound and does not modify the frozen Fraction vectors.

algorithm: Build immutable domain/max-specific tables once. For each960 group, histogram finite magnitudes and prefix count/sum/sumsq. Each scale uses eight contiguous nearest-code buckets and SSE=ss-2*level*sum+count*level^2. Never scan26x238 candidates for every group. Final chosen signed codes are packed by the unchanged physical weight-group mapping.
cpu_gates: Independent direct per-value integer quotient/remainder oracle versus histogram bucket candidate SSE and selected codes/scales; every finite magnitude and possible nonzero max plus25 candidate scales.

Baseline retention, all-zero/signed-zero, nearest half ties and clipping, concentrated outliers, all magnitudes, deterministic genuine channel/group permutations, invalid domain/length/codes/scale rejection.
Every chosen group exact SSE<=original pair; compare both independent dense encoding and nibble packing. Original helper/source/dependencies must remain byte-identical.
